signal: Guidde raised an oversubscribed $50M Series B led by PSG Equity, bringing total funding to $80M, with 3x annual revenue growth

email.body1:
Graham, saw Guidde close its oversubscribed $50M Series B led by PSG Equity, on the back of 3x revenue growth.

Scaling pipeline that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Guidde off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Graham, quick follow-up for Guidde.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually climb faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late, and then it is a scramble to recover the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Guidde needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Graham, last bit of proof for Guidde.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Guidde's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Graham, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I will tailor it to Guidde either way.
